title: Benchmark foundation — retire the bespoke harness, adopt pytest-benchmark
description:
Grounded in project-management/BENCHMARK_STRATEGY.md (dated 2026-08-04), a 7-phase research task that audited the existing hand-rolled `benchmarks/` folder (2,353 LOC, built by PH-6 in EPIC-5) against the current OSS benchmarking landscape and concluded it should be mostly kept, not discarded — but is *mis-scoped*: a custom timing/report/judge/runner doing a job three maintained tools (`pytest-benchmark`, `Locust`, the official LongMemEval harness) do better. This epic lands that foundation: the architecture decision itself (BM-1), the harness retirement (BM-2), pytest fixtures and Db2 lifecycle management (BM-3), deterministic multi-scale corpus seeding (BM-4), and the two genuinely novel measurement primitives no OSS tool provides — a DB round-trip counting proxy (BM-5) and memory/CPU instrumentation via pytest-memray/psutil (BM-6). Every downstream epic (EPIC-14 through EPIC-19) depends on this one.

**Hard sequencing gate — read before starting BM-2.** BM-2 deletes `scripts/run_benchmarks.py`, `benchmarks/common/llm_judge.py`, `benchmarks/retrieval_quality/dataset.py`, and `benchmarks/latency_cost/run.py`. Those exact four modules are what EPIC-11's TRU-5 and EPIC-12's BRUN-1, BRUN-2, and BRUN-3 need to execute (`--suite latency`, `OllamaJudge`, and `run_retrieval_quality()`'s synthetic dataset, respectively) — all four stories are currently "To Do" and were scoped specifically to fill gaps BENCHMARKS.md's own text already documents as pending. BM-2 must not run until TRU-5, BRUN-1, BRUN-2, and BRUN-3 are Done (or explicitly abandoned on the board) — otherwise this epic silently deletes the only tool that can produce those four still-outstanding numbers. `benchmarks/isolation_load/run.py` has the same conflict with EPIC-12's BRUN-4 and is handled inside EPIC-15 (see BM-13) rather than here, since BM-2 only marks it KEEP (port), not delete. See the dated 2026-08-04 'EPIC-13..19 backlog' DECISIONS.md entry for the full research writeup and the explicit list of what was rejected (VectorDBBench, HammerDB, ANN-Benchmarks, k6, JMeter, Molotov, OpenAI Evals, BEIR, asv, Bencher) and why.
